correctness.rationale: The identity P squared equals J and row stochasticity imply J P=J (column stochasticity). A deterministic row cannot occur, because it would force the target row to be uniform while already exhausting the target column. On at most three states every two row supports then intersect; the Dobrushin coefficient is strictly below one and attains a uniform maximum below one by compactness. Four-state forward/backward fair-bit shifts have P squared=Q squared=J but PQ is a nonuniform idempotent preserving one bit. With P_e=(1-e)P+e J, the centered alternating product scales by (1-e)^t; each relevant row has total variation one-half before scaling. The package verifier reproduces 280 exact rational switching cases and 14 feasible three-state rational kernel instances, but these finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: In Shimizu–Shiraga (2021), the dynamic common-stationary mixing bounds explicitly require reversible kernels; our counterexample is nonreversible. Chevalier et al. (2017) give broader Wolfowitz/SIA product frameworks and the scrambling class, not the sharp minimum state count for exact-square-to-uniform kernels or their positive-perturbation switched profile. Vourdas (2022) treats general time-dependent bistochastic chains and entropy/ergodic examples, not this boundary. Speyer (2011) already constructs nondiagonalizable 3-state bistochastic matrices, so a square root of uniform by itself is classical, and nilpotent-centered product phenomena are credited. The exact four-state sharpness is the narrow novelty assessed. Historical priority remains a risk, not an independence assertion.
residual_risks: A classical joint-spectral-radius or stochastic-products theorem might have an equivalent explicit minimal-dimensional square-root-to-uniform counterexample that keyword searches missed.
General nilpotent matrix product constructions underlie the four-state witness; priority claims are limited to the sharp bistochastic dimension boundary and perturbed mixing profile.
No independent external priority or correctness assessment has been performed.

value.rationale: The precise condition that a homogeneous chain perfectly forgets its start after two steps is a natural maximal static mixing guarantee. The proof identifies the exact smallest state count where deterministic switching defeats that guarantee, rather than choosing arbitrary parameter slices. The perturbation family is strictly positive and still has exact static two-step mixing but exhibits mixing times diverging inversely in its perturbation size, making the obstruction quantitatively stable and relevant to dynamic common-stationary Markov theory.
